admissionInfo.text: Acceptance into a UVU Master's program or acceptance into the Graduate Certificate in Leading With Higher Education program by meeting the following minimum requirements: A bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited college/university, a nationally accredited program, or the international equivalent. A 3.0 cumulative undergraduate GPA or a 3.0 GPA calculated on the last 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) of undergraduate work.
